front.title: Problem Statement, Gap Analysis, and Requirements for Intra-Domain Source Address Validation
front.workgroup: Source Address Validation in Intra-domain and Inter-domain Networks

abstract.t: Source Address Validation (SAV) is an important means to mitigate IP source address spoofing (RFC 2827). This document analyzes the gaps in current operational mechanisms for intra-domain SAV. It also identifies the properties that new intra-domain SAV mechanisms are expected to provide.
